content.text:
Clean build. Here's the full redesign summary:

**`globals.css`** — New design system:
- Deep-space navy palette (`#0a0a0f` → `#1a1a24` surfaces)
- Subtle radial gradient background (green + blue ambient glow)
- `glass-card` / `glass-card-strong` utilities with backdrop blur
- `status-badge` components with colored glow (`status-green`, `status-amber`, `status-blue`, `status-purple`, `status-red`)
- `list-item`, `panel-header`, `section-label`, `stat-value` utilities
- Animations: `fade-in-up`, `shimmer`, `glow-pulse`, `marker-pop-in`, `marker-ring`, `dot-grid`
- Timeline layout utilities (`timeline-item`, `timeline-dot`)
- Slimmer scrollbar styling

**`DashboardShell.tsx`** — Layout restructure:
- Glass-card header with ping-dot live indicator
- Map wrapped in `glass-card overflow-hidden` for framed look
- Right sidebar panels each in their own `glass-card`
- Activity feed at bottom spanning full width

**`HeaderStats.tsx`** — Count-up `CountUp` component with ease-out animation, shimmer sweep on cards, colored top border glow per stat

**`OperationsMap.tsx`** — Updated bg class to `bg-bg-surface`

**`PendingRequestsPanel.tsx`** — Panel header with badge count, `list-item` cards with amber left border, status-badge with dot, empty state with icon

**`ActiveTripsPanel.tsx`** — Grouped by status with count badges, `list-item` cards with dynamic colored left border, status-badge per trip

**`ActivityFeedPanel.tsx`** — Timeline layout with colored dots + glow, cleaner expand/collapse

**`DriverDetailPage.tsx`** — Full refresh: glass-card layout, `InfoCard`/`InfoRow` components, status badges, consistent spacing and typography
